messages:
priya_acct: EcoThera flagged their Oct private invoice  they migrated their private deployment from eu-west to us-central mid-month and got billed platform fees for both regions. Procurement put payment on hold.
kevin_billing: Filing FIN-6021. Do we have migration change order or note about cross-region billing?
priya_acct: They have a migration request MR-776 and said migration window was 2026-10-12. No contract line about cross-region pro-rata; AM says they assumed we would credit old region.
nate_engops: quick check of billing_events for resource et-vpc-2 between 2026-10-01 and 2026-10-31 shows bf-16011 platform_fee_eu $21,000 (2026-10-01) and bf-16045 platform_fee_us $21,000 (2026-10-12). Both present.
olga_finance: Finance okay to provisionally credit the unused portion of eu platform fee if migration is validated. Approve provisional credit up to $12,000 pending confirmation. GL: CU-CR-MIGREG.
kevin_billing: I'll mark invoice ET-2026-10 disputed and create provisional credit CM-ET-2026-10-P for $11,900. Approve @olga_finance?
olga_finance: Approved provisional_credit_amount: "$11,900". Post as pending until eng confirms exact prorate delta.
nate_engops: Root cause: migration job created new region resource but weekly rollup had already billed eu full-month. Deletion of eu resource happened after rollup and the decommission hook didn't trigger a prorate because cross-region moves set a "migrate=true" flag not handled by billing. PR to include migrate flows in decomm logic (PR #5057). Backfill queued.
legal-bot: Reminder: cross-region credits may have tax implications. Legal requires confirmation that refund/credit doesn't change contractual pricing terms. Please include contract id CT-889 in final sign-off.
priya_acct: I'll tell the customer: "We've placed a provisional credit of $11,900 while we validate your migration and backfill the billing. We'll confirm final adjustment within 72 hours. Apologies for the inconvenience." Approve?
kevin_billing: approve and include FIN-6021 + CT-889 refs.
nate_engops: Backfill completed  removed duplicate eu platform_fee event bf-16011 prorated -$11,900. ENG-BILL-289 resolved.
kevin_billing: Posting credit memo CM-ET-2026-10-1 for $11,900 and attaching to ET-2026-10. Invoice status: adjusted. Notifying legal for tax sign-off.
olga_finance: Finance will post GL CU-CR-MIGREG $11,900 once CM processes and confirm tax treatment with legal. FIN-6021 -> resolved pending ledger.
priya_acct: Customer replied: "Thanks  procurement cleared the hold and will proceed with payment." Closing loop.
